candidats.description: An open hangar door at NASA CSBF frames the Big Dipper on July 10, 2026, as the EXCITE payload faces outward. Credit: NASA/Kyle Helson Alt text: A telescope is positioned in front of an open hangar door. Image description: The EXCITE telescope peers out at the night sky from the bottom right corner of this image. The camera looks out and up at a large open hangar door to a sky dotted with stars. A line of yellow caution tape cordons off the open doorway.
